subject: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role

Hi team,

Heads up — Rahul (P5 Backend Eng, Platform) shared last Friday that he'll be taking a leave of absence and not returning (resignation effective 10/01). The team is already thin on coverage for the model-serving workstreams that touch Dedicated routing and KV cache optimizations.

I attached a short backfill request and a 3-month cost comparison (internal contractor + contractor-to-hire vs direct permanent hire). Given the hiring freeze and Q4 budget constraints, I'm asking for a one-time "freeze-exception" decision: either approve a temporary contractor for 3 months while we defer a permanent headcount to Q1 2027, or approve an immediate permanent backfill now.

Key tradeoffs:
- Risk to latency/cost initiatives if we delay: moderate — the current owners have overlapping knowledge but capacity to deliver two of the three priority fixes is at risk.
- Time-to-hire: ~8-10 weeks for a strong permanent hire; contractor could be onboarded within 2 weeks.
- Budget: contractor route is ~30% higher on run rate for Q4 but keeps FY27 HC plan intact. Permanent hire consumes HC headcount bucket now.

Asks:
1) Approval (explicit) for a freeze exception to bring on a contractor for 3 months or approval to convert current underspend to a permanent headcount now.
2) If contractor route is approved, sign-off for up to $75k spend for Q4 (estimated).
3) Monica: HR process + any constraints I should flag now.
4) Laura/Vivek: risk acceptance or preference (product / infra priority).

Attachments: org-chart-q3.pdf, backfill-request-form.docx, cost-comparison-3mo-vs-hire.xlsx

Thanks — I think we need to lock this within the week to avoid delivery slippage.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Platform Product (Interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role

Vanessa — thanks for the write-up and attachments. A few quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Which deliverables are at the highest risk (list specific JIRA tickets or milestones)?
2) If we take the contractor route, do we have an identified bench contractor (internal vendor) or will we run an expedited search?
3) Impact to committed Q4 customer promises (yes/no) — call out any active customer launches dependent on Rahul.

Initial read: I lean toward contractor for 3 months to avoid burning HC, provided we can guarantee ramp to the most urgent latency fixes. If we go that way, I want explicit targets for the contractor and a checkpoint on 30/60 days.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Engineering
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role

+1 to Laura's approach. Extra context on funding: we have ~50% of the Q4 infra overrun budget unallocated (we can repurpose up to $60k without an org-level reallocation if leadership signs off). Id prefer contractor for 3 months and then re-evaluate HC in Q1 hiring window — keeps us flexible and preserves headcount for prioritized hires (LLM infra and SRE).

Operational asks if contractor gets approved:
- Vanessa: assign two concrete tickets for first 30 days (I can help prioritize).
- Monica: expedite contractor procurement steps; we need SOW + NDAs in place within 5 business days.

If we get pushback from customers on delivery, we can elevate for an emergency HC approval but that's last resort.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Product Officer
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role

Thanks for the detailed summary. HR position on freeze exceptions: we can approve a short-term contractor for operational continuity with the following conditions:

1) Max duration: 90 days (documented start/end).
2) Total Q4 spend cap: $75,000 (as requested) — finance to be notified.
3) SOW and security onboarding checklist completed before access is granted (we will require SOC 2 attestation for any vendor working on infra).
4) Contractor role must have clear 30/60 day deliverables and a named internal mentor (Vanessa, please assign).

I will open the HR ticket (HR-1428) now and loop in procurement. Once you confirm the SOW owner, I will mark this as approved and route the finance notification.

Monica
Monica Patel
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary coverage vs. permanent backfill — decision request for P5 backend role

Acknowledged. Vanessa: I can be SOW owner and will kick off a 48-hour outreach to our preferred contractors; I already have a shortlist that matches the cost profile and SOC 2 requirement.

Next steps (I'm actioning):
- Draft SOW and share by EOD Friday (9/17).
- Connor to share contractor short-list and hourly estimates (by 9/17).
- Vanessa to assign 30/60 day tickets and internal mentor.
- Monica to close HR ticket and notify finance after SOW receipt.

If everyone is aligned, I will proceed and treat Monica's note as conditional approval.

Connor
Connor O'Brien
Director, Platform Engineering
